installer.notice.title: FaceLogin 1.9.0 Release Notes
installer.notice.body:
Multilingual UI: Simplified Chinese / 한국어 / English across the whole chain (lock screen, Console, installer) — follow the system language or pick manually
Face exposure auto-control (optional): automatically normalizes face brightness to a unified target, so changing environment or lighting no longer affects recognition noticeably. Re-enroll your face after enabling
Passwordless Microsoft-account face unlock: accounts with PIN/Hello only can now unlock directly by face
Memory optimization: models unloaded after recognition and the working set cleared — idle service memory drops from ~60 MB to under 1 MB
Lock-screen status text fixes: no more stale "Recognizing..."/"Face recognized" after a rejected submission or a recognition timeout
Your enrolled face data is unaffected — no re-enrollment needed
